options.denominator: None; absolute count, not a rate
options.reason: A line chart makes the year-to-year movement and longer-term trend easy to follow.
options.interpretation: This directly answers the annual-count question and emphasizes how the totals change over time. A line is a defensible choice for ordered yearly data; it does not explain why the counts rise or fall.

options.denominator: None; absolute count, not a rate
options.reason: Bars make the count for each discrete year easy to compare and read precisely.
options.interpretation: This directly answers how many pedestrian deaths were recorded in each year, with labels that support precise year-by-year lookup. A bar chart is defensible because the years are distinct categories; it does not explain what caused the differences among years.
